If we go back into this war completely, both Trump and Israel have no idea how deeply they’ll be hated. 

No amount of mainstream media propaganda will save them from being thoroughly despised by the American people.

2/3 of Americans don't want this war. If our government worked for us, this would be a no-brainer. But our government works for a different country, so we're forced to die in their wars of choice. And pay billions a day for a war only Israel wants. We are not sovereign.

What has Trump done for the average American? Absolutely nothing. 

What has he done for Israel? Everything they asked for. Including a disastrous war we hate, but are forced to fight and pay for. 

Is he compromised? Obviously.

They have offered Iran absolutely nothing in return. We're not even ending our blockade of them in return. This is just a bullshit way of saying "we tried, but they left us no choice." It's a preemptive excuse for going deeper into the war. Israel is 100% driving this agenda.

Trump is making the maximum Israeli demands of Iran. That they have no enrichment at all, they open up the Strait of Hormuz and they hand over their foreign policy to Israel and promise never to fund any allies. They will never agree to that. This is a way of guaranteeing war.

You guys are a joke. If it’s such great investment for us to give you $320 billion, then as the great allies we are, well let you reap the rewards of the same exact investment - so, give us the $320 billion back! That way, you’ll be enriched, according to your logic.


AIPAC 🇺🇸🇮🇱 (@AIPAC)

No, @RoKhanna, you are Team Ro.

Team America upholds our commitments, stands with allies and helps allies stop terrorists from killing civilians.

Aid to Israel isn’t a handout. It’s a strategic investment th

At least there's one guy fighting for us. And by us, I mean both the overwhelming majority of Democrats who don't want this war and don't want to fund Israel's war machine, but I also mean all Americans. Because huge majorities of this country are against the war and Israel now.


Ro Khanna (@RoKhanna)

No taxpayer $$ to Israel. 

No Israeli PM in Situation Room.

End occupation.

I am Team America. Trump is obsessed with war in the Middle East.

It's time for a new generation for a new moral di

Congratulations to Israel who has succeeded in dragging us back into this war. They told Trump that he is so mighty and strong that he doesn't have to concede anything to Iranians, and he's so stupid he believed it. Now more of us will die and suffer for Israel. Sickening.

We were also told aliens were a conspiracy theory. And now several presidents and Congressmen have confirmed that as well. Do you see the pattern? Every time the government wants to cover something up, they get the media to do it for them, by calling it a conspiracy theory.

Israel’s approval rating is directly proportional to the relative strength of mainstream media. When they dominated, everyone believed that Israel was the victim. Now that less people watch TV “news,” everyone sees Israel as they are - a foreign country taking advantage of us.

When a reporter derides “conspiracy theorists” for questioning the official government narrative, they’re confessing they’re not journalists. They’re enforcers of government’s official narrative. They’re the ones who are supposed to challenge power, instead they do the opposite.
If you are in favor of Israel's occupation of the Palestinians in the West Bank and Gaza Strip, you are an immoral person.

Democratic leadership is sick. Schumer is blaming the Palestinians for being occupied. No, it is not the fault of the victims of the occupation, it is the fault of the aggressors who are oppressing them! Schumer loves Israel more than life itself and he'll never serve America.


Mel (@Villgecrazylady)

“There’s no peace in the Middle East bc Palestinians refuse to believe in the Torah. The Torah says it’s our [Jews] land. And that’s why America must always stand with Israel.”

Wow. He just came

It’s not just Netanyahu. A different guy with the same policies isn’t going to make it any better. Israel has to stop trying to expand, attacking all its neighbors and for God’s sake end the occupation. But it won’t do any of that because we fund and enable their worst instincts.


Barak Ravid (@BarakRavid)

Bibi torched U.S. support for Israel for a generation. Older Republicans and white Evangelicals are the last groups to hold majority favorable views of Israel, according to recent Pew pollin

Why do people keep believing Trump's obvious lies? He said Iran was going to keep the Strait open even though we were going to continue to blocakde their ports. Why would they agree to that? Well, it turns out they didn't. So, they just fired on ships and closed the Strait again.
If you still think that people criticizing Israel are doing it just because they're antisemitic, you might be a lunatic. And not know it.
The mistake Big Pharma made is that they didn't invent a thing called a trope. So that whenever you're criticized about anything you can claim it's a trope, and hence, no one is allowed to say it.

Big Pharma is biggest lobby in the country. They're so powerful we can't even negotiate drug prices. If you say they control Congress, everyone agrees. Israeli lobby is also one of the largest lobbies. If you say they control Congress, everyone in media calls you an antisemite.
